unit.why: A dream narrative in which R. Zvi Hirsh of Zidichov enters the heavenly academy of the Beit Yosef and delivers a halakhic novella there, which the Beit Yosef approves.

stories.start_quote: ופ"א פ׳ מקץ והי׳ רבינו דודי מזידיטשוב
stories.summary_en: In a dream during the week of Miketz, R. Zvi Hirsh of Zidichov enters the heavenly yeshiva of the Beit Yosef, where he is greeted by name. Asked for words of Torah, he explains how Joseph could accept the Egyptians' silver and gold idols: they had annulled them by breaking them. The Beit Yosef praises his novella.
